subject: Pilot budget windows & procurement owners — quick recap
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@orchardplatform.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot budget windows & procurement owners — quick recap

Hi Priya — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and two asks so we can map next steps with finance/procurement: 

One-line summary
- You’re targeting an initial pilot ~3–6 months, starting with a 100–200M token/month workload for selective routing (support and notif flows). Goal is to validate quality and unit economics before wider rollout.

Key pricing items we covered
- Target unit economics: you mentioned aiming for ~$15–25 per 1M tokens as the sweet spot to keep cost-of-feature < $X/month.
- Candidate monthly spend bands we recommended for underwriting the pilot:
  • Band A (Discovery): 0–$1.5k/month (up to ~100M tokens)
  • Band B (Pilot): $1.5k–$5k/month (100–300M tokens)
  • Band C (Early Production): $5k–$20k/month (300–1.2B tokens)
- Procurement thresholds: PO requirement kicks in above ~$5k/month (Band C). If you expect to cross that during the pilot, we should route to procurement now.

Asks / next steps
1) Can you confirm which monthly spend band best matches your finance gating now? (A / B / C)
2) If Band C or crossing $5k/mo is likely, can you share procurement owner + expected lead time for a standard PO?

Attachments: I’m including a short pricing anchors sheet (redwood-pricing-anchors.xlsx) showing per-1M token price ranges by profile and a suggested PO thresholds template.

If easier we can set a 20-min follow-up with Marissa to lock the procurement timeline — she’s on cc. If not, reply with the band + procurement contact and we’ll align internally.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood-pricing-anchors.xlsx - Excel)

From: Priya Shah <priya@orchardplatform.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reyes <t.reyes@orchardplatform.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 17:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot budget windows & procurement owners — quick recap

Logan — thanks for the clear summary. Quick answers and a couple of clarifying Qs: 

- Likely band: Band B in month 1 (100–300M tokens) with the potential to touch Band C by month 3 depending on usage growth. Finance wants to see a 3-month projection before committing to PO.
- Procurement owner: Tom Reyes (cc’d). Tom — can you confirm expected PO lead time for a pilot if we decide to escalate?

A couple of clarifications:
- The $15–25/1M target was a high-level target — our cost modeling assumes $20/1M as conservative. If you have a worked example for a 250M token month showing gross spend and a net after volume tiering, that would help.
- Any flexibility on short-term credits or pilot discounts for early usage? That’s something our product team will ask about when vetting economics.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Integrations
Orchard Platform
(attachment: internal-cost-slate.pdf - referenced)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya@orchardplatform.com>, Logan Wright <logan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Apr 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot budget windows & procurement owners — quick recap

Hi Priya / Logan — looping in procurement playbook details to make timelines concrete. Priya: short answers below.

- PO lead time: for a standard pilot PO we typically see 5–10 business days from receipt of a completed PO + contact info. If your legal/compliance require an SLA addendum, factor an extra 7–10 business days.
- Thresholds we recommend setting in your internal ticket:
  • Auto-approve up to $5k/month (Band B upper bound)
  • PO required > $5k/month
  • Finance pre-authorization if monthly run-rate projection > $12k (early production risk flag)

I attached our PO thresholds template that Priya should be able to pass to Tom. Also, Logan — we can prepare a worked example for 250M tokens: baseline list price, expected volume tiers, and an optional pilot credit of up to 30% applied to month 1 usage (one-off), which we often use to mitigate experimentation risk. If you want me to include a 3-month projection table I can drop it into the Drive link Logan provided.

Attachment: po-thresholds-template.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Ops
Redwood Inference
(attachment: po-thresholds-template.pdf - PDF)

1) Band selection: Priya — treat this as Band B for onboarding. We’ll prepare a worked example for 250M tokens at $20/1M (conservative) and show the effect of a one-time 30% pilot credit in month 1 — Marissa will draft.
2) Procurement: Tom — per Marissa, target 5–10 business days for a PO. If you can share the name/email to send the quote/PO to, we’ll generate a quote and a concise SOW to attach.
3) Next meeting: propose a 20-minute sync on Tue, Apr 21 at 10am PT to review the 3-month spend projection and the PO template. If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and a DocuSign sales order for signature.
